links.note: what 'the Company' means -> East India Company; 25276 is the concept that names it and its seizure of the riyasats, whereas 25275 is the trader-disguise framing
who was ready to face the British government with a handful of sepoys -- that daring is what makes the Colonel recall Robin Hood, 25281
Wazir Ali's single aim, to drive the English out -- 25282 is his hatred of the English; 25277 is the countrywide effort, not his personal aim
whose line the dust-like-a-whole-caravan remark is -- 25290 is that exact image (gard as if a kafila were coming, but a single rider)
why the Colonel's tent stood in the jungle -> to catch Wazir Ali; 25279 is the time-and-place concept, the Colonel's khema in the Gorakhpur forest in 1799
why the Colonel was dumbfounded after the rider left -> the rider was Wazir Ali himself, which is 25292, the jaan-bakhshi
why he killed the Company's vakil -> the vakil abused him and paid him no heed, which is 25288's description; 25289 is the khanjar killing itself and no row in this bank reaches it
whom he complained to -> the East India Company's vakil, the first clause of 25288
who besides the army pursues him -> Colonel Collins; 25278 is the dramatis personae concept that names the Colonel
whom the whole army is chasing -> Wazir Ali, a fugitive precisely because after the khanjar killing he fled to Azamgarh, which is 25289
who was listening to Colonel Collins -> the Lieutenant, one of the four characters listed in 25278
whose rule lasted five months -> Wazir Ali's; 25283 is the five-month rule in which he cleared the Awadh court of English influence
where he took his degree -> Nagpur, named in 25272

on whose summons he refused to go to Calcutta -> the Governor General; 25287 is the post-deposition arrangement concept (sent to Banaras on a stipend), of which the Calcutta summons is the next demand
his maqsad was to free Awadh of the English -- 25283 is exactly that, clearing the darbar of English influence; 25282 is the hatred rather than the Awadh aim
where he was sent after being removed -> Banaras, 25287 verbatim
the tent-in-the-jungle question again (a duplicate of qid:104370) -> 25279, the time and place
